operator.sub: Replies to choose and conversations handed over to a person. The list refreshes by itself.
operator.empty: Nothing to do: no open tasks.
operator.rebuilt: The client wrote again, new variants are ready.
operator.reply_placeholder: Pick a variant above or write your own text
operator.edited_hint: The variant is edited: your text will be sent.
operator.dismiss_confirm: Close the task without an answer to the client?
operator.handover_hint: The bot is quiet in this conversation. Answer the client yourself, then give the conversation back to the bot.
operator.write_hint: The bot keeps answering. Take the conversation over to make it quiet.
operator.cannot_write: You cannot write to this client now: the reply window of the channel is closed.
operator.reject_confirm: Reject? The client gets no answer from it.
operator.dismiss_action_confirm: Close the task without doing anything?

review_reason.always: Every receipt is checked by a person
review_reason.amount_above: The amount is above the threshold

operator.note_placeholder: Why — stays with the receipt, the client does not see it

notifiers.sub: Where the team is told about handovers, replies to choose, channel problems and scenario events.
notifiers.name: Name
notifiers.name_hint: Latin letters, digits, - and _. Scenario actions refer to it by this name.
notifiers.bot_token_hint: From BotFather in Telegram. Stored encrypted and never shown again.
notifiers.chat_ids_hint: One per line: a number (a group starts with a minus) or a channel name. Add the bot to the group first.
notifiers.emails_hint: One per line. Sent through the SMTP server of the admin.
notifiers.events_hint: Scenario events are set in the scenario: action Notify in Telegram or by email.
notifiers.how_text: A scenario action names the notification channel. The message has the scenario, the event, the client and the answers collected so far.
notifiers.remove_confirm: Delete the notification channel {name}? Scenario actions that use it will stop sending.

instagram.token_hint: A long-lived Instagram token from the Meta app dashboard (for tests). The account is checked and subscribed to messages.
instagram.disconnect_confirm: Disconnect {name}? The bot stops answering in it. Conversations stay.
instagram.disconnected_hint: The account is disconnected. Connect it again to turn the bot on.
instagram.setup_text: One Meta app serves every account. Enter these addresses in the app dashboard: the webhook (field messages) and the redirect address of Instagram login.
instagram.not_configured: not set up: META_APP_ID and META_APP_SECRET are empty
instagram.review_hint: Until Meta approves the app (App Review), only accounts added to the app as testers can be connected.
